sources.title: BlinkLinMulT/README.md at main · fodorad/BlinkLinMulT · GitHub
sources.snippet: BlinkLinMulT is trained for blink presence detection and eye state recognition tasks. Our results demonstrate comparable or superior performance compared to state-of-the-art models on 2 tasks, using 7 public benchmark databases.
